audit_items.proof_trace: GetStorageRoot throws InvalidOperationException for non-existent accounts instead of returning Keccak.EmptyTreeHash, violating Ethereum semantics and creating inconsistency with GetNonce/GetBalance which return default values. The proof fails because the null-account path executes ThrowIfNull rather than returning EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT.
audit_items.attack_scenario: If GetStorageRoot is called on a non-existent address during transaction processing, it would trigger an unhandled exception causing a DoS. However, concrete attack reachability is uncertain as internal callers appear to check account existence first (e.g., PersistentStorageProvider.EnsureStorageTree uses GetAccount with null-coalescing).
